name: Bellmore Movies & Showplace

evidence.note: Theater's own page for Moonflower (Santana tribute) at the Showplace on Oct 3, 8 PM.
Reviews call it a cozy, old-fashioned single-screen movie theater.
Listing for a different tribute show here promises sing-alongs and dancing, so some crowds get up during concerts.

dancing.notes: It is a movie theater with rows of seats and no dance floor. Some concert ads here mention dancing, but any dancing would be at or near your seat.

description: An old-style single-screen movie theater across from the Bellmore train station. Its Showplace stage also hosts live tribute concerts.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's 'Bellmore Showplace Theater' is the Showplace stage inside Bellmore Movies. A promoter called Bellmore Concerts also runs shows at this address.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current description is still accurate. The site lists events (e.g. a tribute show 'Hopelessly Olivia' and 'Dolly and Divas' on Nov 21, 2026) but no opening hours (it runs by showtimes) and no public email. The site has no photos of the building or the room, only event posters, so no photos recorded. Contact page also gives (516) 783-3199 for rentals and promoters.

evidence.note: Theater's own contact page: 222 Pettit Avenue, Bellmore, NY 11710; (516) 783-7200; second line (516) 783-3199 for party and promoter questions.
About page: built in 1915, run by the Stampfel family since 1986; Nassau County's last single-screen cinema; shows films plus live shows, plays, comedy and concerts.
Google Maps lists 'Bellmore Movies & The Showplace' (movie theater) at 222 Pettit Ave, Bellmore, NY 11710, phone (516) 783-7200.
